Five colleagues — Anil, Bhavna, Chirag, Divya and Esha — each give exactly one presentation, one per day from Monday to Friday. Use the clues below.

- Divya presents on an earlier day than Esha.
- Exactly one presentation falls between Chirag and Anil.
- Chirag presents on an earlier day than Esha.
- Chirag presents on an earlier day than Divya.
- Anil presents on an earlier day than Bhavna.
- Chirag presents on the day immediately before Divya.
- Anil presents on the day immediately before Bhavna.
- Bhavna presents on the day immediately before Esha.
